description: Replace string tile maps with bounded array indexes in guarded paper-core audits, preserving the original chord geometry and all discrete decisions.

profile.method: Instrumentation wrappers in an isolated Chromium worker. Diagnostic only; this is not clean end-to-end performance evidence.

fixedAudits.method: Serial alternating-order complete audits, including maps. Both policies are warmed once. Kernel load, input loading, comparison and hashing are outside each audit timer. Only elapsed time is excluded from exact output equality.

browserAudits.method: Same complete audit, including maps. Four rounds rotate policy order after one warmup for each policy and input. Loading, warmups and exact comparisons are outside audit timers. current selects the measured backend; cachedJavaScript and forcedWasm isolate backend costs with the same outline reuse.

summary.qualification: Full-resolution (360-cell) audit timings; small 80-cell controls remain in the exact-equality corpus and complete timing rows.

prototypes.method: Isolated browser modules: d623294 string maps, numeric maps and dense neighbor arrays. Five fixed complete audits per runtime at 360 cells. Same forced-Wasm backend to isolate lookup, with four rotating rounds after warmup. Full results/maps must match except elapsed time. No source mutations to the production server.
prototypes.qualification: Exploratory rotating-order forced-Wasm comparisons. Complete maps were serialized after each timer, which can affect later garbage collection. Final production-module comparisons above use direct map comparisons and actual automatic backend selection.

freshHunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

freshFreeBorder.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

productionBrowsers.method: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

qualification: No changed clearance thresholds, seeding, chord distances, topology or acceptance rules. Fresh solves are wall-clock limited and can reach different checkpoints despite identical individual audit decisions. Full-solve timing comparisons are not randomized A/B experiments; no claim of uniform speedup.
